# Machinery Ring Nyandarua

> Farmer-owned service organization in Nyandarua, Kenya providing quality farm inputs, mechanization and agri-services, training, and a marketplace connecting farmers across the region.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Machinery Ring, featured products, and services.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Browse seeds, fertilizers, tools, and produce from verified suppliers.
- [Services](/services): Professional agricultural services including consultancy, soil testing, and mechanization.
- [Resources](/resources): Farming guides, seasonal tips, and frequently asked questions.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos of farming activities, training events, and community programs.
- [About](/about): Mission, vision, values, and team behind Machinery Ring.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the Machinery Ring team.
